structure.unit: Waters of the State, Ports and Harbors

law.catch_line: Board to examine petition and report to court
law.text:
Upon receipt of a copy of any such petition the Board shall examine the same and report thereon to the court upon the following matters:
The average flow of the stream at the point from which water for storage will be taken.
Whether the proposed project conflicts with any other proposed or likely developments on the watershed.
The effect of the proposed impoundment on pollution abatement to be evidenced by a certified statement together with such other relevant comments as the Board desires to make.
Any other relevant matters which the Board desires to place before the court.
